title: RLBubbles
description: Adds chat bubbles for Minecraft mobs (yes, it works with modded entities). The idea comes from Dynamic Surroundings so credit to Orecruncher
body:
RLBubbles is MIT licensed, so you're free to fork it, modify it, and port it to other Minecraft versions.

The mod is inspired by the old Dynamic Surroundings feature where villagers and other entities would occasionally display floating text above their heads.

Huge credit to OreCruncher and the original Dynamic Surroundings project for the inspiration.

Here are a few examples:

![A sheep staring intensly](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5e3b17f143711affef0ac6ea9d907b638200e74.png)

![Example 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e02962387fd8cd6ffc8371ad3d369df9ec06f649.png)

![creper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e6a08e1587b7f36b67ee694f19cab32179ed979_0.webp)

![*looks around* *eats grass*](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3af1558898adef19767c866bfff5bb52c00f3af.png)

Now heres some modded examples!

![you are right! the darkness does feel wrong...](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3973840c6277cd67e9522f29c26606723e35adf2_0.webp)

![dragon :p](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a41b9d9ea5b89a3ffb6a9f1e6214b5e078e87c42_0.webp)

![what are those noises, eh?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2234b3cc491dcb46ab606b5efbac226dcb37d2eb.png)

All dialogue is data-driven and can be customized through datapacks, allowing modpacks and servers to add their own messages, jokes, lore, and mob-specific text bubble things

Anyway, I'm out :p

Happy modding!
